title: Limit Break Traits
doc: Slice toggle. Off: Slices.VerdictForOverlay skips the file below before it
is opened, so none of its rows reach RulePlan. The file is loaded by the
row-edit engine, so it also has no effect while [Slices] ModelRules is off
(ModelRules.Init returns before Overlays.Load).
Files this toggle gates:
EffectModel.limitbreak.csv
WHAT IT IS FOR. The shipped Stress Limit Break traits are TraitClass 6 rows
in TraitModel, and each one carries no numbers of its own: its effect is the
EffectModel row its EffectTypeId points at. This overlay edits those effect
rows, so it changes WHAT a limit-break trait does to the merc carrying it.
The subjects are the two traits the Fatigue track's lower tiers grant by
default, 2007 Checked Out (effect 10505) and 2009 Running Empty (effect
10507). 2014 Off-Duty (effect 10512) has no stat penalty to retune - it
carries SpecialCode 90 BlockMissions and nothing else - so it is not a
subject here. See docs/limit-break-traits.md for the shipped values and
what the file overlays onto them.
INDEPENDENT OF [Slices] Fatigue, on purpose. That toggle decides WHO is
granted a fatigue trait and when; this one decides what the trait does once
a merc has it. They are separable because the game grants these same traits
through its own Stress Limit Break, with no help from this mod, so the
retune applies to a merc who limit-breaks whether or not mission fatigue is
running. Turning Fatigue off and leaving this on is a coherent
configuration, and so is the reverse.
It is a direct overlay: the part of the filename before the first dot names
the game table, and "limitbreak" is the pack's filename tag.
uiDoc: Turn this off and the mod skips this page's file, so nothing on this page is applied.

This page changes what the limit-break traits DO to a merc who carries one. Which mercs get one, and when, is the Mission Fatigue page - the two are separate switches, because the game hands out these same traits through its own Stress Limit Break whether or not mission fatigue is running.

fields.label: Enable Limit Break Traits
fields.doc: On applies this slice's file; off skips it before it is opened. Default true.
